title: Ramsays' $14,000 retrieval reenactment
summary: Suzanne Ramsay tells of Ramsays' $14,000 retrieval reenactment, about unspecified at New Mexico (no place named), and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.
plain: Suzanne Ramsay, speaking on a podcast hosted by Jesse Michels, talks about Hart Canyon near Aztec, New Mexico, where some people say a craft carrying alien bodies crashed. She says she and her family staged a reenactment of the recovery of that craft, and that it cost them more than $14,000 in one week.
